info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Memberships API

params.name: roomId
params.description: List memberships associated with a room, by ID.

params.name: personId
params.description: List memberships associated with a person, by ID. The `roomId` parameter is required when using this parameter.

params.name: personEmail
params.description: List memberships associated with a person, by email address. The `roomId` parameter is required when using this parameter.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the maximum number of memberships in the response.

items.docs:
Lists all room memberships. By default, lists memberships for rooms to which the authenticated user belongs.

Use query parameters to filter the response.

Use `roomId` to list memberships for a room, by ID.

**NOTE**: For moderated team spaces, the list of memberships will include only the space moderators if the user is a team member but not a direct participant of the space.

Use either `personId` or `personEmail` to filter the results. The `roomId` parameter is required when using these para
Add someone to a room by Person ID or email address, optionally making them a moderator. Compliance Officers cannot add people to empty (team) spaces.

Deletes a membership by ID.

Specify the membership ID in the `membershipId` URI parameter.

The membership for the last moderator of a [Team](/docs/api/v1/teams)'s General space may not be deleted; [promote another user](/docs/api/v1/team-memberships/update-a-team-membership) to team moderator first.
